ready.note: ?frozen=1 pins the clock to #t=, seeds the tracers, runs 240 tracer steps without the wall clock and then sets __FRAME_READY (web/js/main.js, frozenFrame). Headless Chromium usually loses its first GL context under software GL; the app reloads itself and the second boot renders.
